body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its 8-inch digital photo frame 'PF8W' during CES 2009.

This innovative design allows you to send or receive digital photos without wires or a PC. Just connect to any wifi network and you can build an entertaining photo and video library with music to display in the office, home or school.
With a multi-card reader and built-in USB, the Digital Photo Frame will show pictures from most memory cards. Add music or voice recordings to the rotating images with MP3 Audio Playback.
With 2GB of memory, you'll never run out of space to save10,000 photos. Keep adding to your collection and friends and family will keep watching.
